messages:
Ellen: quick thread for tomorrow's webinar rehearsal (9:30 PT). two asks: pick final abstract variant and confirm routing + fallback commands. pls react with :one: or :two: for abstracts.

Ellen: Abstract A (concise): "Serving LLMs in production: practical tradeoffs for latency, cost, and reliability." short bullets on when hosted vs dedicated makes sense.

Ellen: Abstract B (narrative): "From spikes to steady-state: how serving choices shape user experience and unit economics." includes a 1-line customer example.

Tom: vote :one: - A reads tight for the landing page and SEO.

Rhea: vote :two: - B is better for the talk flow, more storytelling.

Vikram: quick poll summary: A=4, B=5 (so B wins). we should A/B test landing headers after the webinar.

Ellen: ok B it is. Tom, can you shorten B to one sentence for the registration page?

Tom: updated copy for reg page: "How serving decisions affect latency, cost, and reliability for customer-facing apps." ETA 30m, will paste final.

Rhea: speaker order: open (Ellen), benchmark narrative (Tom), demo (Vikram), panel Qs (Rhea). someone volunteer for chat triage? need two people.

Ellen: I'll do product/SLA triage. Rhea can do lead capture & link drops?

Rhea: yes. I'll also create the HubSpot form with hidden fields and utm. mapping below: hs_webinar_name = "serving_march_2026", hs_channel = "webinar", hs_interest_bucket = "hosting|dedicated|private", hidden field model_demo = "demo_variant". utm_campaign=serving_mar26.

Vikram: demo plan notes: primary route = demo-hosted (redwood/v1-small), fallback = demo-dedicated (redwood/v1-medium-quant). to simulate failover we'll throttle the hosted endpoint for ~10s. stage manager will run the switch command below. demo preserves KV when compatible.

Vikram: switch command (DEMO_TOKEN present on demo VM):

```
# switch to fallback dedicated
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/admin/routes/switch -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEMO_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"route":"webinar-demo","target":"redwood/v1-medium-quant","meta":"demo_fallback"}'
```

Vikram: reset command:
```
# reset to hosted primary
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/admin/routes/switch -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEMO_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"route":"webinar-demo","target":"redwood/v1-small","meta":"demo_reset"}'
```

Tom: note on outputs: quantized medium may slightly alter punctuation in edge cases. we'll use short Q&A prompts to avoid visible diffs and add a caption: "Demo uses short prompts to keep outputs consistent."

Rhea: HubSpot workflow: tag leads with utm_campaign, set property hs_interest based on selection, add to list "webinar_serving_mar26" and notify sales_reps team inbox for follow-up. I'll draft the canned chat replies: pricing, SLA, Dedicated onboarding link.

Ellen: DeployBot, can you schedule a prewarm for demo-dedicated ~8 minutes before start?

DeployBot: Scheduled: prewarm for webinar-demo dedicated pool at 2026-03-24T09:22:00Z (requested by Vikram). :white_check_mark:

Vikram: rehearsal checklist: greenroom VPN 9:10, captions on + start recording 9:25, prewarm done 8m prior, stage manager copy of switch commands, short prompts list in shared doc.

Tom: I pasted the short prompts in the rehearsal doc and trimmed benchmark slides to two bullets + a caveat line.

Rhea: uploaded HubSpot test form and a sample submission screenshot to the rehearsal folder: https://redwood.share/rehearsal/serving_mar26. tested hidden fields and workflow; works.

Ellen: perfect. be in greenroom 9:10 PT. rehearsal 9:30 PT. last call: anyone want to rehearse their 30s intro in thread?

Tom: i'll drop mine in 15m.

Vikram: will rehearse the demo flip once at :30.

Rhea: I'll prepare canned chat replies and drop them in the folder.

Ellen: thanks all. :rocket:
